overview:
A scenic weekend trek from Delhi or Chandigarh: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** trip covers McLeodganj's cafés and monasteries, Bhagsu Waterfall and a night camping on Triund Top with the Dhauladhar range at your doorstep. You leave in the evening in an AC deluxe vehicle and travel overnight.

Day 1 is McLeodganj: the flea market, the Dalai Lama Temple, Bhagsu Waterfall and café hopping, ending with a bonfire and music party at the hotel. Day 2 is the Triund trek (9 km, easy to moderate, up to 9,350 ft) through pine forests and meadows, with a night in camps. Day 3 you trek down to McLeodganj (by about 2 PM), visit Dharamshala Stadium and the tea gardens, and head home, reaching Delhi early on Day 4. Prices start at ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing for regular dates and ₹7,500 for Christmas and New Year batches (5% GST extra).

Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening and meet your team captain and the group.
Overnight journey in an AC deluxe vehicle.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: McLeodganj exploration
itinerary.content:
Reach McLeodganj, check in at the hotel, freshen up and rest for a while.
Explore the McLeodganj flea market and the Dalai Lama Temple.
Visit Bhagsu Waterfall and go café hopping.
Back at the hotel for a bonfire and music party, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Trek to Triund Top | Camping
itinerary.content:
Freshen up and have breakfast.
Set off on the Triund trek through pine forests and peaceful meadows, with views of the Dhauladhar range.
Reach Triund (9,350 ft) and check in to the camps.
Dinner and overnight stay under the stars.

itinerary.title: Trek down | Dharamshala | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early on Triund and have breakfast.
Trek down to McLeodganj (the trek ends around 2 PM).
Visit Dharamshala Stadium and the tea gardens, then depart.
Reach Delhi early on Day 4.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi or Chandigarh. The final pickup point and time are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report 30 minutes early. You travel overnight and reach McLeodganj the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the McLeodganj & Triund Trek cost?
faqs.a: Regular dates: ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,000 on triple and ₹7,500 on double. Christmas and New Year batches: ₹7,500 quad, ₹8,000 triple and ₹8,500 double. 5% GST is extra.

1 hotel night in McLeodganj and 1 camp night at Triund, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, transfers in an AC deluxe vehicle both ways, all sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire and music party in McLeodganj, and a tour curator.

faqs.q: How long and how hard is the Triund trek?
faqs.a: The trek is 9 km and rated easy to moderate, reaching about 9,350 ft. You trek up on Day 2, camp at Triund Top and trek down on Day 3, finishing around 2 PM.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹3,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, then clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
If you cancel, the ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are also no refunds for any inclusion you don't use, and bookings cannot be transferred to someone else.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, good shoes, a daypack, personal medication and a small first-aid kit. The full list is under Things To Pack.
